scope: Authorize 12 fresh Docs attempts. The other 36 remain conditional on both predeclared Docs gates; no efficiency target is claimed achieved.

Shared skill configuration is tested with managed network listeners omitted. This establishes catalog visibility, not a paid exec replay or historical billed token cost.

focused_test_evidence.provenance: Implementer observed successful tool outputs; filesystem logs were not retained. Final reviewer inspected source and native evidence without rerunning these tests.
focused_test_evidence.full_script_test: Implementer reports pass, including 166 Node tests; full shell output retained only in tool history.

provider_availability.basis: The 12 immediately preceding condition06 Docs attempts all succeeded with complete usage. No additional paid health probe was needed or performed for07.
provider_availability.limitation: Recent point-in-time availability only; does not guarantee subsequent task or accounting completion.

conditional_design.docs_gate: Exactly three trials per task and arm; complete usage, no inconclusive outcomes, both success counts positive, Next successes >= original, and 2 * Next_tokens * original_successes < original_tokens * Next_successes. All attempt tokens count; exactly 50 percent fails.
conditional_design.other_functions: At least 30 percent reduction with observed success nonregression.
conditional_design.stop_rule: Retain all12 and report remaining36 not run when either Docs gate fails or is unavailable. No replacement, pooling or historical baseline substitution.
conditional_design.limitations: Conditional repeated development experiment, three repetitions, mutable provider alias. No statistical success parity, stable savings or full functionality coverage claim.

checks_not_repeated: Reviewer reran no tests or provider calls. Candidate product and private native lifecycle evidence are reused because the exact candidate is unchanged.
